matches.note: A single heavenly tablet on which supreme decrees stand. Anzu, set by Enlil to guard the door of the sanctuary (ne₂-reb ki-iṣ-ṣi ... i-qip-šu {d}EN.LIL₂), says lul-qe₂-e-ma DUB NAM-MEŠ DINGIR-MEŠ a-na-ku 'I will take the Tablet of Destinies of the gods' and seizes it while Enlil bathes. In 85:21-22 the Quran is fī lawḥin maḥfūẓ, 'in a guarded tablet'. The tablet that can be stolen through its own guardian against one that is guarded.

passages.text: אֵ֣ל קַנּ֤וֹא וְנֹקֵם֙ יְהוָ֔ה נֹקֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה וּבַ֣עַל חֵמָ֑ה נֹקֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ לְצָרָ֔יו וְנוֹטֵ֥ר ה֖וּא לְאֹיְבָֽיו
יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וגדול וּגְדָל כֹּ֔חַ וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֑ה יְהוָ֗ה בְּסוּפָ֤ה וּבִשְׂעָרָה֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְעָנָ֖ן אֲבַ֥ק רַגְלָֽיו
